subject: general
question: What significant event is marked on 11th September in India as "Digvijay Diwas"?

options.text: The signing of the Indian Independence Act
Swami Vivekananda’s speech at the World’s Parliament of Religions
The birth anniversary of Jawaharlal Nehru
The foundation day of the Indian Constitution

solution:
The correct answer is __**Swami Vivekananda’s speech at the World’s Parliament of Religions**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India observes Digvijay Diwas on 11th September to honor Swami Vivekananda’s landmark speech at the First Parliament of the World’s Religions in Chicago on this day in 1893.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swami Vivekananda’s speech at the Parliament of Religions in Chicago began with the iconic words, “Sisters and Brothers of America,” which earned him a standing ovation and global recognition.**
 
• He emphasized the universality of religion, called for interfaith understanding, and condemned sectarianism and fanaticism, promoting global harmony.
 
• Vivekananda recited from the Bhagavad Gita, advocating that holiness, purity, and charity transcend all religious boundaries.
 
• The speech played a significant role in India’s spiritual renaissance and continues to inspire youth empowerment and global unity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Swami Vivekananda__

 __
 
• A prominent spiritual leader who represented India at the 1893 Parliament of Religions in Chicago, advocating for religious tolerance and global unity.
 
 
 
• The Parliament of Religions (1893)__
 __
 
• A historic event in Chicago where religious leaders from around the world gathered, with Swami Vivekananda delivering a powerful speech on religious unity and harmony.
 
 
 
• Digvijay Diwas__
 
 
• An observance in India to commemorate Swami Vivekananda’s impactful speech, which highlighted India’s rich philosophical heritage and spiritual identity.
